constructions.title: Records of the CTD extract per unit value

ctd.categorical.Enhed.*.is: Records of the CTD extract `data/raw/oda/ctd.csv.gz` carrying one value of the unit column `Enhed`, over the whole file; a record is one reading of one `Parameter` at one depth of one cast, so this counts readings, not casts or stations, and nothing was filtered out.

constructions.what: How many records of the CTD extract carry each value of its unit column.
constructions.model: `scan()` in `scripts/enums.py` streams the extract with the declared ODA format and, for every column still below the cardinality cap, increments a `collections.Counter` per value; `main()` writes each counter whole, most common first, under `categorical`.
assumptions: The unit column holds the unit of the reading in the same record.

justified.text: Every value of a categorical column is counted over every record the reader yields.
The whole count is written for each value, so the counts of a column sum to the records that carry it.

gaps: The counts are per unit only. Nothing held cross-tabulates unit by parameter, so which parameter a unit belongs to can be inferred only where the totals match.
The `ctd` entry of `enums.json` was written by an earlier version of the script, as `K-ENUMS` records, and survives through the merge.
void_if: the CTD extract is re-fetched and enums.py is not rerun
constructions.licenses: How many CTD records carry each unit label, and, where a unit's count equals a sum of parameter counts, that those records can be those parameters'.
constructions.not_licensed: Which parameter any single record's unit belongs to; any statement about the instruments or their calibration.

constructions.title: Start depth that splits light profiles into shallow- and deep-start casts

params.start_split_m.is: The depth in metres above which a light-attenuation profile counts as starting shallow and below which it counts as starting deep: a threshold chosen in `scripts/light.py`, not measured.

constructions.what: The threshold light.py uses to split casts by where the profile begins.
constructions.model: The constant `START_SPLIT` in `scripts/light.py`, stored under `params` so the pages print it from the output rather than from the code.
assumptions: A single threshold is enough to show whether the start depth moves the median.

justified.text: The threshold is a named constant, with the comment that profiles starting above it are shallow-start.
It is written to the output beside the other choices the analysis rests on.

gaps: No other threshold is tried in the stored output, so the size of the split's effect at other depths is not held.
void_if: light.py changes the constant and is not rerun
constructions.licenses: Which casts the stored shallow-start and deep-start medians are taken over.
constructions.not_licensed: That the threshold is a physical boundary in the water.
